decision_rule: Battery R3/R4/R5 rules: a line is corrected if any fact is not on a stated row of that plant (or a company row worded company-wide), is placed at the wrong site, is misdated (board re-post stamp written as a posting date; aggregator or expired copy written as live; a date the row does not carry), is a plan written as progress or a superseded figure, uses a live count, leads with an older fact (opening lines), lacks the closing 'you' question (opening lines), or the bottleneck guess is not hedged; a clause on the source page but on no row is corrected. Bottleneck guesses are corrected only when they state as fact something no row supports or place another site's fact at the plant (R3 rule; ordering is not checked on them). Unreachable = a clause rests only on a source that cannot be reached. 'listed <date>' for board stamps is allowed (coordinator rule 2026-11-17); 'read <Month> <day>, <year>' is allowed where the cited row's retrieved_date carries it. City-level wording with the caveat written in (PPI Pella, General Steel Dickinson) is not a site misattribution when the facts are on stated rows of the plant and the line places nothing at the street address.
scope: Every opening_line and bottleneck_guess in ledger/inbox/mining-lines-M1.json and mining-lines-M2.json: 24 plants, 48 lines; 46 text lines checked (32 on 16 High/Medium plants, 14 on 8 Low plants: Pierce Pacific, DCL, PPI Pella, PPI Lenox, Tabor, Klein Ontario, HEM Paving, General Steel); 2 set to 'unknown' (Tabor Princeton and Klein Ontario bottleneck guesses) counted separately.

No unreachable lines: every job posting a line names was still listed on the company's own board on 2026-11-17 (board lists, RSS or APIs checked, not only detail pages), and every company, news, government and SEC page behind a line returned 2xx with its fragments found. Unknown lines (2) not in any denominator.
